Class LessonsLearned

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearned
public class LessonsLearned extends Object

Title: LessonsLearned Class

Description: The LessonsLearned class represents a single lesson learned, stored persistently in the database. It provides validation for lesson titles and descriptions, along with static methods to create, delete, and update lessons in the database.

This class implements the Create, Update, and Delete operations required by Contributor Story 1 (add lessons with core information and manage them). The id and author attributes support Contributor Stories 2 and 4 (list and examine only the lessons I have added). Read operations on collections of lessons are provided by LessonsLearnedList.

Planned attributes: The Curator lock epic (TP3) will require a locked flag for the whole lesson and per-field locks, so Contributors cannot edit locked fields or delete a locked lesson (Contributor Stories 1-2). Contributor Story 3 and the Curator time and effort epics will require experience data (what was done, how it was done, time taken, and effort by team member), stored as a separate list per lesson since one lesson may have many attempts.

  • Field Details

    • id

      private int id
      Unique id assigned by the database. Source: Contributor Story 2 (select a lesson to examine). Rationale: titles may repeat, so update and delete need a key that identifies exactly one lesson.

    • title

      private String title
      Short title of the lesson. Source: Contributor Story 1 (core information) and Story 2 (list used to pick a lesson). Rationale: identifies the lesson in lists and searches. Validated by TitleRecognizer.

    • description

      private String description
      Full text of the lesson learned. Source: Contributor Story 1 (core information). Rationale: holds the actual content of the lesson. Validated by DescriptionRecognizer.

    • author

      private String author
      Username of the Contributor who created the lesson. Source: Contributor Story 2 (list of lessons I have added) and Story 4 (only see my own content). Rationale: lets the system filter lessons by author.

      public static boolean createLesson(String title, String description, String author, database.Database db)

      Method: boolean createLesson(String title, String description, String author, Database db)

      Description: This method validates the title and description, then creates a new LessonsLearned object and saves it to the database. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed from the title and description.

      title - is a string that specifies the lesson's title
      description - is a string that specifies the lesson's description
      author - is a string representing the user creating the lesson, matches the user's username
      db - is the database where lessons are stored
      Returns:
      true if creation is successful, otherwise false
